description: Pinned snapshots the gallery tracker reads, so core never needs the sibling checkouts: the pptx.gallery data kinds, pages, card previews, published catalog ids and coming teasers, and the opf-editor switch dimensions. Refresh with node scripts/build-gallery-tracker.mjs --snapshot-gallery <pptx-gallery> --commit <sha> or --snapshot-editor <opf-editor> --commit <sha>.
